archetype: Swiss grid — ruled sections, numbered eyebrows (01–09), asymmetric 12-column grid, charcoal smoke base with bone sections; executed visibly differently from Tuscany Courtyard (the only other Swiss-grid Pakistani site): Tuscany is ivory/wine editorial with an oversized-type hero and one small portrait image; this is a charcoal/bone smokehouse with a full-width flame-photo hero, headline set low over the photo, dark trust band, and a karahi menu board as the lead section
business: Frontier Barbecue, Clifton Boat Basin, Karachi
colour: Charcoal smoke #1B1A18 base, bone #F4EEE2 light sections, deep ember red #A6261F accent (white on #A6261F 7.20:1; deep red #7E1B14 small text on bone 8.85:1), smoke grey #6E675F secondary text on bone, hairline rules #D8CFC0 / #3A352F. No orange UI accents. Banned combo (cream bg + serif heading + rounded pill buttons + boxed hero photo): 1 of 4 (bone sections only — display type is Barlow Condensed grotesque, buttons are sharp-cornered rectangles, hero is a full-bleed photo)
fonts: Barlow Condensed (display, 600/700, uppercase) + Barlow (body, 400/500/600/700) via Google Fonts — neither used by any prior Pakistani site
hero: Full-width close-up photo of meat skewers over open flames (Pexels 2233729) filling the hero width, dark gradient at the foot, headline 'KARAHI, STRAIGHT OFF THE COALS.' set low over the photo in Barlow Condensed — NOT split 50/50, NOT mosaic, NOT carousel, NOT type-led with one small image, NOT centred badge

summary_5_lines: Business: Frontier Barbecue, Shop # SC-10, Sea Breeze Center, Block 5 Clifton, Boat Basin, Karachi — BBQ and mutton karahi restaurant, 4.3 stars on Google from over 2,900 reviews, phone +92 300 9281235, open daily 12:00 PM–3:00 AM.

Why chosen: Day 5 first reserve from the phone-confirmed top-15 shortlist — Blazon Salon dropped out (no live listing verifiable; F-11 salon now trades as House of Salons with its own website), and Frontier is a Boat Basin karahi name with no official website.

Design direction: Swiss grid in charcoal smoke, bone and deep ember red, Barlow Condensed + Barlow, full-width flame-skewer hero with the headline set low over the photo — executed visibly differently from Tuscany, the only other Swiss-grid Pakistani site (see 6-axis diff in the report).
Signature elements: karahi menu board, live-fire feature with a 4-step cooked-to-order process, animated counters (real numbers only), lightbox gallery, FAQ accordion, map + hours card.

Not verified: founding year (a '1972' claim is reviewer-only — not stated as fact); menu prices ('Prices on request' once); delivery/takeaway policy (call to confirm); whether the 12 PM–3 AM hours hold every day vs reviewers' evening-only description (site shows JetlyGo hours with a call-ahead note); no verified logo (clean text wordmark, none invented).

uniqueness_check.vs_last_10_archetypes: Swiss grid was last used by Tuscany (Day 1, entry 2) — outside the last 10 sites (entries 3–12: brutalist, editorial, collage, bento, playful rounded, retro poster, dark luxury, clean clinical, scrolling story, full-bleed cinematic). Archetype does not repeat any of the last 10.
uniqueness_check.vs_siblings_day5: Nirala Hotel is a split-screen grand-hotel site; Khadim Sweets & Bakers is a bold-brutalist-type sweets site (Unsplash). This is a Swiss-grid BBQ smokehouse (Pexels) — archetype, fonts, colours, nav and section order all differ; Pexels IDs cannot collide with Khadim's Unsplash set.
uniqueness_check.vs_tuscany_swiss_grid: Same archetype label, different execution on all 6 axes: (1) archetype execution — Tuscany ivory editorial grid, this charcoal/bone smokehouse grid; (2) hero — Tuscany oversized type + one small portrait image, this full-width flame photo with headline low over it; (3) fonts — Playfair+Karla vs Barlow Condensed+Barlow; (4) colour — ivory/wine/sage vs charcoal/bone/ember red; (5) signature — Tuscany tabbed menu + signature cards, this karahi board + live-fire process + counters; (6) nav/section order — own set (Karahi/The Grill/Live Fire/Family Hall/Gallery/Visit) vs Tuscany's Italian/Mediterranean/Thai tabbed flow.
